==Usage instructions==
Cut and paste the following code into your article, then put the relevant specifications after the "=" signs.
<pre class="wrap">
{{Top}}
{{Lightsaber
|image=
|name=
|model=
|type=
|culture=
|creator=
|created=
|destroyed=
|discovered=
|owners=

|hilt shape=

|crystal=

==Data fields==
*image &mdash;
*name &mdash;
*model &mdash;
*type &mdash;
*culture &mdash;
*creator &mdash; Who created the lightsaber
*created &mdash; Date and location created
*destroyed &mdash; Date and location destroyed
*discovered &mdash; Date and location discovered
*owners &mdash; List of individuals who owned the lightsaber, in chronological order
*hilt model &mdash;
*hilt shape &mdash;
*hilt length &mdash;
*hilt material &mdash;
*crystal &mdash;
*blade type &mdash;
*color &mdash; The color of the blade
*blade length &mdash;
*mods &mdash;
*weight &mdash;
*protection &mdash;
*capacity &mdash;
*range &mdash;
*design &mdash;

*precede &mdash;

*purpose &mdash;
*affiliation &mdash;
